Welcome to the Meissen online shop - your exclusive access to over 300 years of craftsmanship and tradition in porcelain. The MEISSEN porcelain manufactory has been producing high-quality figurines, dinner services and vases by hand since 1710. Every piece you find in our online shop stands for centuries-old craftsmanship and modern design innovation. MEISSEN is more than just fine tableware - it is a piece of history. Our products are created through the exceptional craftsmanship of skilled porcelain painters, designers and manufacturers, who undergo years of training to bring you the best quality. From classic blue onion to modern design collections - every piece is unique. Our online sshop offers you a large selection of products from various categories: In the MEISSEN online shop, we offer you not only traditional designs, but also modern and exclusive collections that will enrich your home. The MEISSEN MUG Collection and the MEISSEN Espresso Collection are perfect gifts or additions to your porcelain collection. The elegant Vide-Poche bowls made of Meissen porcelain are also particularly popular. Meissen porcelain is also the perfect choice for special occasions such as Christmas, Easter, Weddings and anniversaries . In our MEISSEN online shop you will find a variety of gift ideas , such as personalized jewelry pendants or mugs are suitable as a special gift idea for your loved ones. Custom-made products are also available on request - giving you a truly unique gift. Thanks to our user-friendly webshop, you can discover and shop the beauty, craftsmanship quality of Meissen porcelain from the comfort of your own home. Whether for personal use or as a gift – we offer you a wide selection and secure delivery so that you can enjoy our products quickly. Browse through our popular categories like Tableware , Figurines , Fine Art , Home Deco , und Jewelry , and experience the fascination of Meissen porcelain. Add more elegance to your life - with Meissen porcelain.
